JiJi Cat Keybinds

Welcome to the Jiji Cat layout; I am the author Qi Yuan Cat. I know many beginners have hardly touched Java MC, so they don't know what these keys trigger, which makes the game hard to get into. So as a handsome guy I naturally can't let everyone get confused and waste play time fumbling around, so I made a separate layout to explain the basics for you.

Movement: wasd
w forward
a left
s back
d right
the wasd letters on the keyboard

Break: L  Place: R
L is short for Left (left click), R is short for Right (right click)
Pick block: Mid
Mid is middle mouse, can be used to switch items

Left and right click are the two sides of the mouse

Hotkeys
f1 hide HUD
f2 screenshot
f3 debug
f3+b hitboxes
f3+h advanced debug
f3+g chunks

f3+b mode switch
f3+c coordinate record
f3+n spectator
f3+a reload chunks
f3+q:
f3 all hotkey hints
f5 toggle view

Letter F switches offhand
Letter E opens inventory
Letter Q drops items

Info hint at the bottom right:
Game Settings - Accessibility - Show Subtitles

Friendly reminder: after opening any More options in this layout, when returning to out-of-game please tap Close in-game first, otherwise there is no close key. E.g. the expansion options inside CMB, KDB and Left/Right More (this may be fixed in a later version; making this is not easy, please understand)
